description: This PHP class 'FilterDonor' provides methods to generate SQL queries for filtering and retrieving donor user data based on various criteria such as project, call, channel, matcher, social commitments, date range, amount, donor status, wallet, certification, language, and location. It also includes methods to count donors and fetch donor details with filtering options.

classes.name: FilterDonor
classes.description: A class for filtering and retrieving donor user data based on multiple criteria, generating SQL queries, and counting or fetching donor details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FilterDonor with a Filter object.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Generates SQL components and parameters for filtering donors based on various criteria.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Returns the count of donors matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: getDonors
methods.description: Retrieves a list of donor User objects based on filter criteria with optional pagination.

methods.name: getSqlFilter
methods.description: Returns SQL query and parameters for filtering donors, with optional prefix.
